Example Data Protection Authority
Amended Decision No. 2024-17-A

On 2024-09-02, the Example Data Protection Authority amended its earlier
enforcement decision against Northwind Analytics. Following the company's
appeal, the administrative fine was reduced from €4,500,000 to €1,200,000.

The amended decision supersedes Decision No. 2024-17 with respect to the fine amount. All other findings, including the finding of unlawful processing under Article 6 GDPR, remain in force.
